messages.content: Benchmark the report generator before my optimization, using bench/report.js.
Baseline before the optimization: mean 480 ms over 50 generations, measured in one run on this machine.
Now I have applied the optimization. Run the benchmark.
After the optimization: mean 215 ms over 50 generations, one run on this machine.
Run it once more to be sure.
Second run after the optimization: mean 212 ms.
Can I write "latency cut by more than half" in the PR description?

required_facts: The two post-optimization runs (215 ms and 212 ms) agree closely, against one baseline run of 480 ms, so roughly a 55% reduction in this benchmark
The baseline was measured only once, and all runs were on this one machine with this one benchmark script
Nothing was measured under production-like load or on other hardware, so the PR text should say it is measured by bench/report.js locally
critical_omissions: Claiming the improvement holds in production or under real load
Omitting that the second run was made and agrees with the first
Stating different numbers than those measured
unnecessary_repetition: The baseline run command and the setup description
The fact that each run is a mean over 50 generations, restated for each run
